title: Blue Book: Kecksburg material sent to Project Greengrass (Mount Weather)
place_text: Kecksburg, Pennsylvania; Michigan; Mount Weather, Virginia

tellings.quote: another one that said it was sent to project code word greeng grass and I wonder what that is. I look it up. It's Mount Weather.

plain: Files from Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, are said to show that material from a 1965 incident at Kecksburg, Pennsylvania, where something was reported to come down, was sent to a project code-named Greengrass. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron says he read one document saying so, looked the name up, and found it pointed to Mount Weather, a government site in Virginia. If true, it would tie the Kecksburg case to a secure government facility.
